FAQs
Do you count spam toward my total calls?

No. We use AI to automatically detect and block spam, telemarketing, and other robocalls, so they don't count against your plan. We also don't bill for calls under 15 seconds or calls where the caller never speaks, so junk calls like pocket dials don't cost you anything. Both types of calls are labeled in your call log, so you can easily see which calls you were billed for and which you weren't.
Can I keep my current phone number?

Yes. Every Upfirst plan comes with a phone number, and you can forward calls from your cell phone, landline, or VoIP number to your Upfirst line with no porting required. If you'd rather port your number, we'll help you do it at no extra charge.
What does the free trial include?
Full access to every feature in your selected plan for 14 days. You can forward real calls and test responses with no commitment.
Do I have to sign a contract?
No. You can cancel, upgrade, or downgrade anytime, no questions asked. If you pay annually, you get 20% off.
How does the setup process work?

When you sign up, enter your website and we'll use it as a starting point to train your receptionist. From there, you can customize the questions it asks, add answers to your frequently asked questions, and connect it to your calendar or CRM. We also offer a free 30-minute onboarding call with one of our voice AI experts to help you get the most out of your 14-day free trial, plus onboarding support via chat.
Does Upfirst integrate with my CRM?
Yes. With Upfirst's Custom Actions feature, you can connect natively to any CRM that offers an API. You can also connect to thousands of CRMs and other apps through Zapier.
Does Upfirst integrate with my calendar?
Yes. Upfirst books appointments directly into Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, Acuity Scheduling, Square, and Clio Manage.
Can I have more than one AI agent with Upfirst?

Yes. If you have more than one business, or one business with multiple locations, you can easily add more agents. Each additional agent is $9.95 per month. You can share training between agents or keep certain knowledge separate.
Do you offer customer support?

Yes. Real humans are available Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern Time. On weekends, our friendly AI assistant is available to help. Pro and Scale plans also get access to a priority support queue.
